analysis.reasonEn: Closed lower for 3 consecutive sessions, RSI remains in oversold territory at 21.2. MACD histogram holds at -32.9447, indicating continued weakness. ADX at 29.5 confirms a clear trend, with -DI significantly outperforming +DI, signaling bearish momentum. The 5-day low of $1814.04 matches the 20-day low of $1814.04, failing to form a new Lower Low. A break below the swing support at $1804.11 could lead to further declines.
